verdict.rationale: Cubic's docs clearly show automatic review on every new PR (cubic-docs-4), with contextual feedback via chat/tour features, contextual code selection, and reply threads for clarification (cubic-docs-6, -9, -10), plus fix suggestions pushed directly to the PR (cubic-docs-7). Community feedback is mixed—some praise contextualized comments (cubic-comm-1, -2, -7) while others criticize comment quality/noise in the broader AI-review category (cubic-comm-3, -9)—but this is general skepticism rather than a concrete documented failure specific to cubic, so it tempers quality/confidence rather than downgrading to disputed. Missing for 10: independent, cubic-specific hands-on benchmark of contextual feedback accuracy beyond first-party docs and mixed anecdotal community reports.
